en.account: Pro supports custom read/fetch MCP connections. Full MCP, including write actions, requires Business, Enterprise, or Edu and workspace administration.
en.recommended: Deploy a private HTTPS MCP with OAuth. Use Secure MCP Tunnel when the server must remain on a private network.
en.limitations: Do not rely on Plus for an individually developed MCP: the dedicated Developer Mode requirements do not clearly list it. Custom apps are added on the web; Agent mode does not use them.

zh.account: Pro 可连接仅含 read/fetch 的自定义 MCP。包含写入操作的完整 MCP 需要 Business、Enterprise 或 Edu，并受工作区管理。
zh.recommended: 部署带 OAuth 的私有 HTTPS MCP；若服务器必须留在私网，可使用 Secure MCP Tunnel。
zh.limitations: 不要把 Plus 当作个人自建 MCP 的可靠前提：专门的 Developer Mode 要求没有明确列出 Plus。自定义应用从网页端添加，Agent mode 不会调用。

en.account: MCP itself needs no premium client tier. Model access still requires a Coding Plan or API provider; the free Qwen OAuth tier ended on April 15, 2026.
en.recommended: Use stdio for a local server or Streamable HTTP for a hosted server, configured with qwen mcp add or settings.json.
en.limitations: The consumer qwen.ai web chat does not document the same arbitrary MCP URL flow as Qwen Code.

zh.account: 启用 MCP 本身不需要高级客户端套餐，但模型仍需 Coding Plan 或 API 提供商；Qwen OAuth 免费层已于 2026-04-15 结束。
zh.recommended: 本地服务器使用 stdio，托管服务器使用 Streamable HTTP，并通过 qwen mcp add 或 settings.json 配置。
zh.limitations: 普通 qwen.ai 网页聊天没有与 Qwen Code 同等明确的任意 MCP URL 添加流程。

en.account: No general account path for adding an arbitrary self-hosted MCP URL is currently documented.
en.recommended: Use TRAE for a developer client, or Coze and Volcengine products for a hosted agent using Doubao models.
en.limitations: Built-in or partner MCP availability in a product does not prove that arbitrary custom servers can be added.

zh.account: 目前没有明确公开的普通账号添加任意自建 MCP URL 流程。
zh.recommended: 开发客户端优先使用 TRAE；使用豆包模型的托管智能体可考虑扣子或火山引擎产品。
zh.limitations: 产品内置或合作方 MCP 可用，不代表用户可以添加任意自定义服务器。

en.account: MCP servers can be selected from the marketplace or added manually. Model quota, region, and client availability remain separate conditions.
en.recommended: Use TRAE instead of the consumer Doubao chat app when manually connecting a developer-owned MCP server.
en.limitations: Recheck the current client UI and quota before setup because product availability can change.

zh.account: 可以从市场选择或手动添加 MCP Server；模型额度、地区和客户端可用性是另外的条件。
zh.recommended: 需要手动连接开发者自建 MCP 时，优先使用 TRAE，而不是普通豆包聊天应用。
zh.limitations: 产品可用性可能变化，配置前应重新核对当前客户端界面和额度。

en.account: Creating an MCP-based plugin is free; hosting, model, and third-party service usage can still cost money. Private-network connections are an enterprise-tier feature.
en.recommended: Provide an HTTPS hostname, choose no auth, service token/API key, or OAuth, then test and publish the plugin before using it in an agent or workflow.
en.limitations: A bare IP address is not accepted as the plugin URL. Workspace administrators can restrict feature and resource visibility.

zh.account: 创建基于 MCP 的插件本身免费，但托管、模型和第三方服务仍可能收费；私网连接属于企业级功能。
zh.recommended: 提供 HTTPS 域名，选择无认证、Service Token/API key 或 OAuth，试运行并发布后再用于智能体或工作流。
zh.limitations: 插件 URL 不接受裸 IP；工作区管理员可以限制功能和资源可见性。

en.account: Local desktop extensions are available to free Claude Desktop users. Remote custom connectors require Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise.
en.recommended: Use a desktop extension for local access or add a remote connector URL in Settings > Connectors.
en.limitations: On Team and Enterprise, an Owner or Primary Owner must first add the organization connector.

zh.account: Claude Desktop 免费用户可使用本地桌面扩展；远程自定义连接器需要 Pro、Max、Team 或 Enterprise。
zh.recommended: 本地访问使用桌面扩展，远程访问则在 Settings > Connectors 中添加连接器 URL。
zh.limitations: Team 和 Enterprise 需要 Owner 或 Primary Owner 先添加组织连接器。

en.account: Requires Gemini Spark access, age 18 or over, a personal Google Account, Keep Activity enabled, and current eligibility in the United States.
en.recommended: Add the MCP URL from Gemini web Connected Apps, then use the connection in Spark on web or mobile.
en.limitations: Currently English-only and not a general connection path for accounts in Japan, or for work and school accounts.

zh.account: 需要 Gemini Spark 访问资格、年满 18 岁、个人 Google 账号、开启 Keep Activity，并符合当前美国地区资格。
zh.recommended: 从 Gemini 网页版 Connected Apps 添加 MCP URL，之后在网页或移动端的 Spark 中使用。
zh.limitations: 目前仅支持英语，不是日本账号或工作、学校账号的通用连接方式。
